subject: The death message receiver 00814560, the wreck handler 00824B60 behind vtable slot 7Ch, the breakup receiver 00814520 and the sink state 008110F0 writes.
run_time_evidence: none: the bsp_game.exe harness does not load a mission, so no frame reaches these paths (checklist rule 6).
headline: 00814560 is __thiscall(unit) with RET 0 and reads no part of the 9Ah message; the class field +B0h is read by the sender 00827A90, not by the receiver.
A damage death reaches the kill list, and therefore on-killed slot 80h, only when the class descriptor's KamikazeDamage +510h or KamikazeBlastDamage +514h is above zero.
vtable slot 7Ch is a third death slot, tail-dispatched by slot 74h at 009263AE; the ship override 00824B60 is where the wreck's physics is set.
There is no sink timer: +828h (sinkTime, named by the executable's own _ship dump) is written only as zero by 008110F0 and 00824B60 and is read by nothing in the image.

corrections.was: id 9Ah when [[this+538h]+B0h] < 0.0f, otherwise a breakup message
corrections.is: the constant at 00D7A220 is the double 100.0, not zero. 00827ACA FLD float [desc+B0h], 00827AD0 FLD double [00D7A220], 00827AD6 FCOMIP ST0,ST1, 00827ADA JBE 00827B14: the breakup branch is taken when 100.0 <= [desc+B0h], so 9Ah is sent when [desc+B0h] < 100.0.

corrections.doc: docs/UNIT_DAMAGE_AND_DEATH.md, 'a unit that is shot to death never runs the on-killed hook'
corrections.was: damage reaches only the destroy list, so slot 32 (vtable+80h) never runs for a damage death
corrections.is: true only when the class has no kamikaze damage. The 9Ah receiver 00814560 calls 00926D90 BSP_MissionEntity_Kill(unit, 1) at 00814595 when [desc+510h] > 0 or [desc+514h] > 0, which queues the entity on the kill list 00F899B4; the same fixed step's flush at 0092751F then dispatches vtable[80h]. The delivery is local and in-step: 0077C2A0 copies the message into session+24Ch with the current tick and fixed-step row 9 (00778450 BSP_Session_PumpStep) drains it before row 15 (009273A0).

corrections.was: the mapping from a class file field to +514h/+518h is unread
corrections.is: docs/SHIP_CLASS_FIELDS.md names them: +510h KamikazeDamage (00831A05), +514h KamikazeBlastDamage (00831A4A), +518h KamikazeBlastRange (00831A8F), all NumberOr with default 0.0f. The unit death explosion at 00819C14 therefore uses the kamikaze blast damage and range.

corrections.doc: docs/SESSION_MESSAGE_DISPATCH.md, '00814560 contract: unread' and '00780090 was not opened'
corrections.was: the 9Ah receiver and the second caller of 0077FE80 were unread
corrections.is: both are read in full here. 00780090 is __thiscall(entity, message) RET 4 and passes a null third argument to 0077FE80; its only caller 007F0030 fans a 4Bh message out to the members of a group.

vtable[70h](1) -> 0077D1A0 destroy message 4Eh -> 00926C80 queues the destroy list 00F899A8
selector: 100.0 > [desc+B0h] sends 9Ah, otherwise the 98h breakup message from 00761310 behind two controller tests and a random roll against [00424C40()+65Ch]
0077C2A0(unit, msg, 7, 0) copies it into session+24Ch with the current tick
the session pump drains it, the ladder falls to 0077FE80, the default dispatches vtable[164h], 00821FD6 calls 00814560

world expiry, which skips this entity: +6Ch is set by 00922FD0 BSP_SceneNode_Kill, not by this path

sink_rule.statement: The wreck settles and rolls because 00824B60 makes three one-off physics writes; nothing integrates a sink timer.
